title: The Airlines I Fly Across India, Vietnam, and Thailand (and 2 I Avoid)
meta_title: Best Airlines for Southeast Asia and India (From Someone Who Flies Them Monthly)
subtitle: IndiGo, Vietnam Airlines, and AirAsia are the 3 I trust, VietJet and Air India are the 2 I avoid, with real fares, safety ratings, and a cheeky baggage trick
description: The 3 airlines I trust flying between India, Vietnam, and Thailand (IndiGo, Vietnam Airlines, AirAsia) and the 2 I avoid (VietJet, Air India), with real fares, safety ratings, and baggage tips from a full time nomad.

faqs.question: Is VietJet safe to fly?
faqs.answer: Yes. VietJet holds a perfect 7 out of 7 safety rating from AirlineRatings and has kept it since 2018, which puts it among the safest budget airlines in the world alongside names like easyJet and Southwest. The real complaints about VietJet are delays, cancellations, and fees for almost everything, not the safety of the aircraft. If you are flexible on timing and traveling light, it is a reasonable way to save money.

faqs.question: Which is better, IndiGo or Air India?
faqs.answer: For reliability, IndiGo. It carries about 66% of India's domestic market, runs close to 89% of its flights on time, and flies one modern Airbus family, which keeps it consistent. Air India has slipped to about 24% of the market and runs closer to 86% on time. It is genuinely improving since the Tata takeover, but it is still inconsistent, so I book IndiGo whenever the route gives me the choice.

faqs.question: What is the cheapest way to fly around Southeast Asia?
faqs.answer: AirAsia. It is the biggest budget airline in the region, with hubs in Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok and a route map that reaches almost everywhere, and Skytrax has named it the best budget airline in the world for 17 years running. The trick is to travel light, because the cheap base fare assumes no checked bag, no chosen seat, and no meal. Add those back and the price stops being special.

faqs.question: Is Vietnam Airlines worth paying more for?
faqs.answer: If reliability matters on that particular trip, yes. The base fare already includes a 23kg checked bag, a meal, and a seat you pick, it is the most punctual airline in Vietnam, and it carries a perfect 7 out of 7 safety rating while ranking as the 19th safest airline in the world for 2026. I pay the premium on any flight where a delay would cost me a connection or a day I cannot get back.
